_comment: Which reply leads to which line. The one thing about an NPC the client has never held.
The client ships every line an NPC can say and every reply it can be given, and nowhere does
it say which goes with which - measured across all 6,467 of them. That pairing has always
lived on Ankama's server, so it cannot be extracted or measured. It has to be decided, and
this is where the decision goes.
npc         the NPC's id
map         0 for wherever it stands; a map id to say something different there
opening     which line it starts on; the first one when left out
lines       one per thing it says, each with what can be said back
next        the line that reply leads to; left out, the conversation ends
And what a reply is FOR, which is what stops a conversation offering everything at once:
startsQuest  this reply hands that quest over. Not the same as `quest`: this one is how a
quest begins, so it is offered to somebody who has NOT got it.
quest        only offered while that quest is under way.
step         and only while it is on that step.
afterQuest   only offered once the quest is finished.
Where the conversation opens, when it is not always the same line:
openings     tried in order, the first that holds wins; none, and `opening`. Each has a
`message` or a `byBreed` table (breed id to message) and any of: `before`
(quest neither started nor finished), `quest` (under way), `step` (and on that
step), `objective` (and that objective done), `after` (quest finished).
pushes       a line the NPC opens by itself, with no click, once a step of a quest ends:
`afterStep` and a `message` or `byBreed`. The tutorial's voice does it.
params       what a reply shows beside it, as effects: a number, or an array whose first
number is the effect and the rest what it names, [34, 2511] for «starts quest
{ "npc": 1088, "map": 0, "opening": 3312, "lines": [
{ "message": 6047, "choices": [ { "reply": 7846 } ] } ] }
A line with no replies is fine now: the client draws its own Leave button and the X closes the
window, because the server answers the kla it sends. It did not before, which is why an NPC
with nothing to say back used to trap you in the conversation.
WHERE THESE COME FROM. The ids are the client's own. The wiring - which reply leads where -
is read off the walkthroughs at dofuspourlesnoobs, which write the reply options out in
French, and matched back to ids with tools/dialogue_from_guide.py. Inside one NPC the text
identifies its lines 98.3% of the time, and the reply ids do not have to be Ankama's: the
server sends the ids and the client sends back what it was given, so any id with the right
text works as long as the tree agrees with itself.
mutation      the reply gives this mutation item after its teleport (the Orbalantir's).
endsMutation  the reply takes the player's mutation away after its teleport.

dialogues.why: PortailIncarnam.pcapng, frames 106-125: click portal actor -20001 (template 4398); question 30637, reply 36979; question 30638, reply 36977 closes the dialogue and loads Astrub 192416776. The destination cell remains configured in interactives/teleports.json.

dialogues._note2: «Consejo de clase» (2009). The guide gives it to the Conseillere Archie at [4,-19] with the requirement «On marche sur des oeufs», which is our 1959. Its step 2631 carries dialogId 0, so there is NO measured hand-over line: it hangs off her opening line with reply 36990 «Demander la raison de sa convocation», which is the only one of her 59 that talks about a summons and fits a class council. The reconstruction is ours; the requirement and the NPC are the guide's.

dialogues._note: «He visto el anuncio que has puesto» requires having clicked 489412, the tavern building on the outdoor map 153878787. The guide says «Cliquez pour accepter l offre», and the element carries the SAME id on the two adjacent maps [0,-3] and [1,-3], which is what a building that spans both does. It is the oddest one on the map that is not the door: the other two candidates were discarded because 32613 is the phoenix rocks and 42509 is the entrance door.

The recruiter's six lines and five replies, in the order their texts follow one another: the muse on the militia, «Hablar de la milicia», the creed, the interrupted tirade, two «Seguir escuchando», «Gracias por la explicación» and the send-off. They are the lines of «Vaya par» (quest 1994), whose step asks to come and see both recruiters; without a tree the template's opening went out with the chain's last reply.

The guided tutorial's Mysterious Voice, as the capture of the whole tutorial has it: 60352 «¿Estás bien?» with «Desplazarte.» (effect 2192), which starts 2545; the first steps walked (idz 3226) and the voice opens by itself on the god of the character's class, then «Basta de cháchara» and «Ver cómo se materializa un camino» (2192 twice), and the window closes. The god's line, its reply and the next line are the class's own, in breed order. Whoever lingers gets the four lines that tell them to go, each answered by the next of its four replies.

Ganymed on the celestial puch's platform, as the tutorial capture has him: 57134 «Te doy la bienvenida a Incarnam» with «Dirigirte hacia el puch celestial para atacarlo» (2192, 192) while 2545 waits on him; back from the first fight (2502 on 3169) 57133 «¡Bravo! He metido algunos objetos en tu bolsa» with «Buscar en tu bolsa los objetos y equipártelos», six 193 for the six items and 34 «Empieza una misión» naming 2511. Before that fight, his «¡Adelante, sin miedo!»; with 2511 under way, «Con tu nuevo equipo...»; afterwards, the puch is there to train on.

Ganymed by the jalatós' pen, as the tutorial capture has him: after the fight (2502 on 3173) 57132 «Tus oponentes han mordido el polvo» with «Dar saltitos de impaciencia» (30 naming objective 19173, then 1142); the characteristic points still to share out (3184), the line on which element each characteristic masters; then 60411 «¿Has elegido tu vía?» with «Quedarte para entrenar» and «Unirte al maestro Curro», both showing 2192 and 34 for quest 1629, the second starting it.

Master Curro in the tutorial's jobs room, as the capture of the whole tutorial has him: 20676 «¡Saludos, joven!» with «¿Cómo va eso?», then 20677 with «¿Qué materiales me van a hacer falta?» (30 naming objective 9656 and eight 1150), then 20678 with «Explorar el lugar.» (five 1150 and 2192); once the ring is made, 20681 «¡Has trabajado muy bien, #1!», his name in it, with «Dirigirte a la salida.» showing quest 1630 and starting it. In between, the reminder of what the ring needs; afterwards, his «No hay nada como la satisfacción...».

The celestial chafer pikemen of the combat room, as the tutorial capture has them: 20706 «llama a los chafers al rescate» with «Empezar el combate contra los tres monstruos» (911, the fight of content/fights/npc_fights.json, once Master Darmas has been heard) and «Retirarte»; once beaten, «juega con su lanza».
The celestial chafer explorer of the combat room: the same fight from his «llama a los chafers como apoyo», and «se prepara para la revancha» once beaten.

Master Darmas in the combat room, as the tutorial capture has him: 20700 «Eres #1, ¿verdad?», the name in it, with «Estoy dispuesto a demostrar lo que valgo.», then 20744 with «Seguir escuchando.» (30 naming objective 9685), then 57155 with «Dirigirte hacia una criatura para provocarla.»; after the chafers, 21200 «¡Has ganado!» with «Sobresaltarte al ver aparecer a Ganymed» (350, 3007), on which Ganymed comes in (jsn, actor -20004) and speaks.

Ganymed coming into the combat room after the chafers, as the tutorial capture has him: 57149 «¡Bravo, #1!», 57220 on changing class while a novice, 57221 «Antes de que abandones el templo...» with «Seguir a Ganymed» (31 naming step 2250, 777), which takes the player to the Dofusarium (jru 241443329).
